data = [(cell('Paired measurements', f'B{r}'), num('Paired measurements', f'C{r}'), num('Paired measurements', f'D{r}')) for r in rows]
n = len(data)
y_vals = [d[1] for d in data]
x_vals = [d[2] for d in data]

def compute_ranks(vals):
    indexed = sorted(list(enumerate(vals)), key=lambda x: x[1])
    ranks = [0.0] * len(vals)
    i = 0
    while i < len(indexed):
        j = i
        while j < len(indexed) and indexed[j][1] == indexed[i][1]:
            j += 1
        avg_rank = (i + 1 + j) / 2.0
        for k in range(i, j):
            ranks[indexed[k][0]] = avg_rank
        i = j
    return ranks

y_ranks = compute_ranks(y_vals)
x_ranks = compute_ranks(x_vals)

mean_y = sum(y_ranks) / n
mean_x = sum(x_ranks) / n

cov = sum((y_ranks[i] - mean_y) * (x_ranks[i] - mean_x) for i in range(n)) / n
result = round(cov, 6)
